whatIs: Public APIs is a collaborative directory of public APIs for developers, with more than 1,400 entries across more than 50 categories, from animals and weather to video and artificial intelligence. It has a keyboard shortcut (Ctrl K or ⌘ K) for searching.
It's a good fit when you need data for a project, a prototype or an exercise and want to quickly see which APIs exist on a topic before choosing one.
uses: Finding a weather, movie or animal API to feed a practice project.
Exploring which data sources exist in a category before designing a new feature.
Adding an API you know to the directory through the link for submitting suggestions.
caveats: It's just a directory: each API has its own terms, limits and authentication requirements, which you should check in its documentation.
The home page shows ads and a section of sponsored highlights, so not everything that appears first is an editorial recommendation.
Since it's a collaborative list, check that the API is still working before depending on it.
pricingNote: The directory is free and the repository is MIT licensed; the cost of each API depends on its provider.
idealFor: Anyone looking for a public API for a project or prototype.
